van_de: Xe dap dien va xe may dien mini cho hang kho phan biet giua bicycle va motorbike
quyet_dinh: Gan motorbike neu co ket cau dong co dien ro rang va khung xe may; chi gan bicycle cho xe dap co truyen thong
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2.2: Xe 2 banh dien co khung xe may gan motorbike; xe dap co hoc gan bicycle

van_de: Xe tuk-tuk va xe loi bi may pre-label nhan nham thanh car hoac truck do co mai che va khung lon
quyet_dinh: Tat ca phuong tien 3 banh cho khach hoac cho hang deu gan three_wheeler bat ke co cabin hay khong
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2.7: Moi phuong tien 3 banh thuong mai (tuk-tuk xe ba gac) phai gan three_wheeler

van_de: Nguoi lai xe va nguoi ngoi tren thung xe ba banh kho xac dinh box phuong tien om den dau
quyet_dinh: Tach rieng nguoi thanh box person doc lap; box three_wheeler om sat phuong tien khong bao gom nguoi ngoi
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 3.1: Nguoi dieu khien va hanh khach luon gan box person rieng biet om sat phuong tien

van_de: Xe dap bi bay doi nhan thanh motorbike; nguoi duyet doi lai bicycle nhung keo box trum ca nguoi lai
quyet_dinh: Tach biet hoan toan box bicycle (than xe va banh xe) va box person (nguoi lai) khong keo box xe trum len nguoi
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 3.2: Box xe dap chi chua khung va banh xe tuyet doi khong trum len nguoi lai
